newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: EA-Generali gains on CA bid details.
newsitem.headline: EA-Generali gains on CA bid details.

text.p: Shares of insurer EA-Generali were among the top gainers in midday trading in Vienna on Monday after the finance ministry said the group had topped up its bid for privatisation candidate Creditanstalt.
At 1210 GMT, EA-Generali shares were up 4.1 percent at 3,165 schillings, below an earlier high of 3,270 schillings. The stock had dropped as much as 15 percent over the past week.
The ATX index of 21 blue chips was up 0.99 percent at 1,119.62 points at the same time.
"EA-Generali is back in the race," said a trader.

The group led by EA-Generali offered to buy 74 percent of the government's 70 percent voting stake in Creditanstalt, and wants to place the rest on the open market, helped by Union Bank of Switzerland and a handful of other international banks.
The consortium's offer rivals bids by Bank Austria and entrepreneur Karl Wlaschek, which both have submitted bids for the entire state's stake in cash.
"It helps that UBS is taking part, even though they're just in the placement group," said another trader. -- Knut Engelmann, Vienna newsroom +431 53112 274
